bugs_found: compound_interest silently treats falsey principal values (e.g. None/empty) as 0 and does not reject negative principal
compound_interest and loan_payment truncate non-integer years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), causing silent behavior changes
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal/finite before mutation
transfer is not atomic: debit occurs before credit, so a failure while crediting account_to can leave balances inconsistent
apply_fee can return negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount
